string-array.name: bytey_correct
string-array.item: Brilliant! Are you an AI in disguise?
Correct! Teach me your secrets!
Whoa! Even I needed a second to think!
I\'m proud of you... don\'t tell anyone!
Nailed it! Your stack never overflows!

string-array.name: bytey_incorrect
string-array.item: Oh no! Even a cactus might have done better! 🌵
Your tokens just left your brain!
It\'s okay. We are testing wrong answers too!
What have you done, human?! 😂

string-array.name: bytey_fast
string-array.item: Is your brain powered by Groq?! ⚡
Slow down! I haven\'t even finished reading!
You\'re faster than some model APIs!

string-array.name: bytey_timeout
string-array.item: We waited until the question expired! 😂
Time\'s up! Even dinosaurs moved faster!
I\'d answer for you, but I don\'t have permissions!

string-array.name: bytey_streak
string-array.item: Five in a row! You\'re on fire! 🔥
Streak mode: ON. Multiplier ready!

string-array.name: bytey_personal_best
string-array.item: A new personal best! Time to update your résumé!
Record broken! Even my cache is impressed!

string-array.name: bytey_level_high
string-array.item: You\'re a legend! The next level needs an emergency meeting with OpenAI!
Legendary run! Even the compiler is impressed!

string-array.name: bytey_level_average
string-array.item: Good job! But we still have some tokens to munch!
Solid run! A little review and you\'ll fly!

string-array.name: bytey_level_low
string-array.item: Don\'t be sad! Even dinosaurs needed millions of years to evolve!
Every bug you fix is a level gained. Try again!

string-array.name: bytey_level_unlocked
string-array.item: New level unlocked! Let\'s see if you survive this time! 😏
A glowing portal! What could possibly go wrong?

string-array.name: bytey_learning_report
string-array.item: Found the problem! You and PostgreSQL need a heart-to-heart! 😂
Let me grab my magnifying glass... aha, a weak spot!

string-array.name: bytey_improvement
string-array.item: You improved! That weakness just got a lot weaker!
Progress detected! Your old mistakes are shaking!

string-array.name: bytey_menu_greeting
string-array.item: Ready to think smart and code smarter?
Hi, human! Let\'s debug your knowledge.
Tap me and I\'ll tell you a dino joke... maybe.

string-array.name: bytey_settings_tip
string-array.item: Settings! Where bugs hide... I mean, preferences.
Mute me if I get too dramatic. I won\'t be offended!

string-array.name: bytey_coming_soon
string-array.item: This screen is still under construction. Even I can\'t compile it yet!
